GET /api/credentials/trust-score/history.notes: Returns history data points with trend (change, change_percentage, direction)

GET /api/reviews/admin/stats.notes: Returns pending_count, approved_count, rejected_count, recent_activity (admin only)

POST /api/reviews/admin/approve/{id}.notes: Requires admin role, returns 403 for non-admin

POST /api/reviews/admin/reject/{id}.notes: Requires admin role, reason passed as query param
